title: SCP-718, Eyeballs
description: It’s not just watching you… it’s making sick and watch back.
body:
Eyeballs adds a new creature. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-718, also known as Eyeballs.


SCP-718 is a tall, stalk-mounted eye that stalks the player. When they detect a player, they slowly approach, and stop at a distance of five blocks, but if the player comes within three blocks, they will find themselves staring back. Killing an SCP-718 causes the eye to tear open. This may sometimes create a Black Bubble, which will hatch into a new instance of SCP-718. If the player is standing at a closer range, there is a chance to receive the Eye Infection effect which disorientates your vision over time. If a player dies while infected, a new Black Bubble will appear and hatch into another SCP-718.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-718 spawn?

SCP-718 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster.

► How can I stop SCP-718 Bubbles hatching?

To prevent new SCP-718 instances from hatching, SCP-718 bubbles must be lit on fire to prevent them from hatching. SCP-718 only spawns bubbles or infects players when the creature is not set on fire.

</details>



![SCP-718](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20cebca1532e0b11970972acfa6f8f394c9281b8.png)

SCP-718 are large, organic eyeballs mounted on long, thin stalks. They remain stationary until spotting a player, at which point they slowly approach and never breaking eye contact. Once they reach within five blocks, they stop. At three blocks, the player becomes locked in their gaze. When killed, SCP-718 tears open. Occasionally, this releases a Black Bubble that hatches after 20 seconds into another SCP-718. Close-range kills carry a risk of applying the Eye Infection effect, that will disorientate your vision after time. If you die with this effect, while not being lit on fire, a new black bubble spawns that will hatch into a new SCP-718 Instance. Fire is the only way to prevent SCP-718 from infecting you or spawning a black bubble.
